parameters.query:
=DECLARE @d DATE = CAST('{{ $('Weekday Baseline').item.json.todayDate }}' AS date);
SELECT
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), @d, 112) AS check_date,
    CAST(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM TsMgmt.dbo.HolidayCalendarKR
        WHERE HolidayDate = @d
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bit) AS found_in_db,
    ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 HolidayName FROM TsMgmt.dbo.HolidayCalendarKR WHERE HolidayDate = @d), '') AS holiday_name,
    ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 SourceType FROM TsMgmt.dbo.HolidayCalendarKR WHERE HolidayDate = @d), '') AS source_type,
    ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 SourceYear FROM TsMgmt.dbo.HolidayCalendarKR WHERE HolidayDate = @d), 0) AS source_year;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ ({ type: 'message', summary: $json.teamsSummary, text: $json.teamsSummary, attachments: [{ contentType: 'application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive', content: { type: 'AdaptiveCard', body: [{ type: 'TextBlock', text: $json.teamsTitle, weight: 'Bolder', size: 'Medium', wrap: true }, { type: 'TextBlock', text: $json.teamsAttentionText || '', wrap: true, spacing: 'Small', isVisible: Boolean($json.teamsAttentionText) }, { type: 'TextBlock', text: $json.teamsSummary, wrap: true, spacing: 'Small' }, { type: 'FactSet', facts: [{ title: '알림 대상', value: $json.activeUsersText || '없음' }, { title: '휴가자', value: $json.vacationUsersText || '없음' }, { title: '저장소', value: `${$json.repoOwner}/${$json.repository}` }, { title: '브랜치', value: $json.branch }, { title: '확인 회차', value: $json.checkSlotLabel || '' }, { title: '변경 기준', value: $json.compareSinceLabel || '' }, { title: '비교 범위', value: `${String($json.previousSha || '').slice(0, 7)} -> ${String($json.currentSha || '').slice(0, 7)}` }, { title: '커밋 수', value: String($json.commitCount ?? 0) + '건' }, { title: '파일 수', value: String($json.fileCount ?? 0) + '건' }, { title: '마지막 커밋 시각', value: $json.currentCommitDateText || '' }, { title: '확인 시각', value: $json.checkTime || '' }] }, { type: 'TextBlock', text: $json.teamsWarningText || '', wrap: true, spacing: 'Medium', color: 'Attention', isVisible: Boolean($json.teamsWarningText) }, { type: 'TextBlock', text: $json.teamsDetails || '', wrap: true, spacing: 'Medium', isVisible: Boolean($json.teamsDetails) }], msteams: { entities: Array.isArray($json.teamsEntities) ? $json.teamsEntities : [] }, '$schema': 'http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json', version: '1.4' } }] }) }}
